reviews.title: Worst customer service
reviews.text:
I had an extremely frustrating experience with this company, both because of the poor customer service and because of serious issues with the app and booking system.

The biggest problem was that the system somehow booked me for the wrong date. I entered the information expecting the booking to be made for the date I selected, but the system did not process it correctly. This is not a minor inconvenience when it comes to a reservation—it can completely disrupt someone’s plans. A booking system should be one of the most basic and reliable parts of a service like this.

What made the situation even worse was trying to get help afterward. The customer service experience was incredibly disappointing. Instead of receiving quick, clear, and helpful assistance to resolve a problem that was caused by the booking system, I had to deal with an unnecessarily difficult process. The experience left me feeling like I was dealing with a system that was designed to make things harder rather than actually help customers.

The app itself also needs significant improvement. The interface and overall experience were frustrating, and the fact that the booking system could result in the wrong date being reserved is especially concerning. When customers are trusting an app with something as important as a reservation, the system needs to clearly confirm the date, time, and other important details before finalizing anything. There should also be an easy way to correct mistakes when the system itself

reviews.title: No Accountability, Gaslighting is the Answer
reviews.text:
I called customer service prior to packing to verify how many luggages I prepaid as I had purchased the tickets months prior and couldn’t remember.  I was given the wrong information that resulted to 1 unused bag that Breeze airline wouldn’t refund understandably.

I called CheapOair Customer Service to let them know that I showed up with 1 luggage less and wasted that prepaid cabin bag because their agent didn’t say that I was allowed 3 total bags but just said 2 checked-in luggage with a personal item.  I requested for the refund based on the wrong information their agent gave me.  They called after their “investigation” to say that there will be no refunds as I didn’t use the luggage. I then explained again that it wasn’t because I didn’t need to use it, but it is because of the wrong information their agent gave me and asked to review the recorded call.  A few days later I got another “investigation” result that wasn’t favorable.  As a matter of fact, they denied they received the call prior to the flight.  So basically, not only did I get no accountability or apology, I also got gaslit because  apparently their records show that I never made the call.  How convenient.  Keep the money, you’re welcome and no thank you!  We will take our business somewhere else.

Like, I literally just got the verification code to sign in and as the page opened this “rate our app” box popped up. If anything it was great timing to fuel me to write this because I get to tell you how I think you should not force us to check in thru any app. Just a link to our internet web browser and to a check in page with the ability to do it from there will do just fine. But instead the link brings you to our browser, only to redirect us to our App Store. Where we have to download this app to get anywhere. Truth be told, I’m almost so annoyed by this I’m thinking about canceling my flight. I’ll just rebook it somewhere else.

reviews.title: Lier Agent ripped me off
reviews.text:
Rating: 1 Star (Zero Stars if I Could)

This was, without question, one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve ever had.

I specifically asked the CheapOair agent how much checked baggage would cost before I purchased my ticket. I was told $70–$80 per bag. That information turned out to be completely wrong.

When I arrived at the airport, I was charged $200 per bag. Since I was traveling round trip with two checked bags, I ended up paying an unbelievable $800 in baggage fees.

I feel the agent lied to me just to get the sale. If I had been told the real baggage cost, I would never have booked through CheapOair. Instead, I was blindsided at the airport with an enormous bill and had no choice but to pay it.

I feel completely ripped off and deceived. Whether it was intentional or grossly negligent, the result was the same: I lost hundreds of dollars because I relied on the information their agent gave me.

Save yourself the stress, frustration, and expensive surprises. Verify every fee directly with the airline and think twice before booking through CheapOair. Based on my experience, I will never use this company again.

reviews.title: Cancellation without notice
reviews.text:
It is ridiculous that neither Cheapoair nor the airline provided any email or text notification regarding changes or cancellations to an international flight. There is no reasonable excuse for travelers to discover that their flight has been changed or canceled only after arriving at the airport or reaching the gate.

When customers book international travel, timely communication is essential. A simple email, text message, or app notification could prevent unnecessary stress, confusion, missed connections, and additional expenses. Failing to notify passengers of major itinerary changes demonstrates poor customer service and a lack of respect for travelers’ time and money.

I am extremely disappointed with this experience and would not recommend using Cheapoair for international travel based on the lack of communication alone.

reviews.title: Misleading Pricing and Poor Support Experience
reviews.text:
I’m extremely disappointed with my experience using your portal.

The pricing displayed initially feels misleading — low prices are shown to attract customers, but additional costs and issues appear later in the booking process. It creates a frustrating and untrustworthy experience.

The worst part was that the baggage policy was not clearly communicated during booking. Because of this, during a very short layover, passengers were expected to collect their bags and re-check them for the next flight. This is extremely inconvenient and unrealistic, especially with limited connection time.

How can travelers be expected to change flights and manage baggage transfers in such a short duration without proper warning or guidance? This lack of clarity caused unnecessary stress and confusion.

What made things worse was the customer support. Getting assistance was difficult, responses were unhelpful, and resolving issues took far longer than expected. A travel platform should provide clarity and support, especially when customers run into problems, but that was not my experience at all.

Please don’t book using this third party especially for parents.

Best regards.

reviews.title: My Trip with cheap-O-air
reviews.text: My trip to Saginaw itself was fine, I didn’t have an issue with my flights or anything when headed to the destination. The problem was as when I was headed back, when united changed my flight while I was at the gate getting ready to board, it went from me actively boarding to a 5+ hour layover. I chatted in to receive help through customer service and they completely lied to me telling me I had to be at the airport for 3+ hours in order for them to not change my flight time. I hadn’t been any any of the airport for more than 2… not only that but they lied and told me that I had to have a minimum of an hour and a half layover or my flight would be changed. Another lie, thankfully a UA gate worker was able to help me change and get onto the correct flight reducing my layover from 5 hours to 20 minutes. I’m never going through cheap-o-air again because that’s exactly what you get, cheap customer service that lies to you and won’t help you. Next time I’m flying directly through United.

reviews.title: Horrible Company

After wasting too much of my time trying to still upsell, I was told they would charge me $55 to cancel!  Said it was because it hasn’t been cancelled within 24 hours.  After I had wasted time on the phone think that I had done just that!  Horrible shady company.  Nickle and dime you to death and then stand on it as ‘policy’.  Just because it’s some arbitrary policy, doesn’t make it right!
